agent_priors_used: Agents are path-dependent and salience-driven: prior context biases exploration toward recently seen patterns, causing local optima and compounding errors over >5-10 steps unless reset or calibrated abstention is enforced — distinguished from SPIDER evidence which shows verbatim replay hitting 0/100 and cross-family key adoption inflating coverage.

Long-horizon agent cost is super-linear in novelty fraction: each repair/retrieval creates new decision points that can themselves fail, so honest cost must count retrieve+verify+repair+freshness probe and amortize at f=10 rather than using bijective n*3200 formulas — prior predicts current product economics artifacts.

Semantic similarity retrieval collapses under distribution shift to orthogonal alias families (header/body/auth) where lexical overlap is removed; structure-aware retrieval is required but cannot be evaluated without correct-family gating — explains frontier coverage ceiling.

Research lanes naturally tunnel: repeated MEASUREMENT_INVALID on same substrate encourages patching infrastructure rather than asking whether the claim is testable on available substrate (e.g., TodoMVC hash-SPAs have no title variance, SPAs don't leak) — predicts Intel/Physics Gate0 exhaustion.

Competitive browser-agent products will default to deterministic replay with DOM-hash invalidation because it is deployable without research risk; scientific leverage must come from orthogonal mechanisms (parameterized templates, tool/API bypass, freshness probes) that replay cannot achieve — frames Stagehand as economic baseline SPIDER must beat at n>=0.25 while matching at n=0.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER is substrate-constrained, not hypothesis-constrained: 7/10 claims are MEASUREMENT_INVALID in the recent window, 280 experiments total, with only narrow synthetic POCs surviving (single-field param distill, Flask HS256 fingerprint, Bayesian K=12 on synthetic SPA). Real LLM/browser transfer remains unproven: C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON all invalid on WebArena-Verified v2 family hold-out due to kernel-commit gaps, bijective cost formulas (n*3200), and blocked JWT/session plumbing. Frontier (10/10 semantic-resolve) and Intel (13-streak cross-site) are tunneling with diminishing returns (0.55 coverage ceiling, 0/10 mixed failure, 0/3 Gate0 after 20+ searches); Runtime and Product are IDLE yet jointly block the central promise. Highest information gain is to fix the writable/auth substrate first, then execute one honest, family-stratified, cost-disciplined test of parameterized inheritance reducing residual novelty vs strong baselines including shipped Stagehand. Physics exhaustive SPA hunting should be parked after the next definitive correlated-DOM barrier/timescale test if it remains BC~0.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout correctly diagnoses measurement-substrate dominance, tunneling concentration, cross-lane dependencies (runtime blocks graph/physics/product, graph commit blocks product, frontier adapter needed for product) and proposes honest-cost discipline and fallback to static export. Adopted its prioritization of runtime fix and honest residual-novelty economics as highest leverage, and its warning to stop exhaustive LFS/CAP enumeration. Overruled its suggestion to keep frontier on endpoint-catalog bake-off: judged joint multi-channel composition addresses the 0/10 mixed failure ceiling that bake-off cannot, and is last warranted semantic-resolve test before park. Challenged scout's implicit parity that physics should continue barrier tweaks indefinitely: limited to one definitive genuine-DOM test with exact Gamma-ratio correction before PARK if BC~0 persists.
